description: This source file defines extension methods for the ISerializerBuilder interface in the Orleans.Serialization namespace. The methods allow configuring serialization options and adding assemblies to the builder, facilitating customization of serialization behavior in Orleans projects.

classes.name: SerializerBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISerializerBuilder to configure serialization options and manage assemblies.

methods.name: Configure (Func<IServiceProvider, IConfigureOptions<TypeManifestOptions>> factory)
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder with a factory function that creates configuration options based on IServiceProvider.

methods.name: Configure (IConfigureOptions<TypeManifestOptions> configure)
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder with a pre-existing configuration object.

methods.name: Configure (Action<TypeManifestOptions> configure)
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder using a delegate to modify options.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Adds an assembly to the serialization builder, registering its associated provider types for configuration.
